messages:
Priya: quick sync — we need to re-weight RICE for Q3. two candidates: 'seed-features' (customer-facing small bets) vs 'core-routing' (platform/foundation). Feels like scoring is anchored to last quarter. What's everyone's quick take?
Marco: core-routing effort looks bigger than we thought. + infra unknowns (k8s, autoscaler tuning). probably double the effort estimate :/ 
Jorge: data note — from experiments, seed-features drove 18% lift in MAU for one cohort but noisy. retention delta looks promising though.
Lina: to reconcile: suggest we separate effort into 'blocked' vs 'workable'. Blocked items (legal/kms, infra) get +1 multiplier. That changes RICE math.
Aisha: design heads-up — seed-features need 2 designer sprints for flows + accessibility pass. add ~80h.
Priya: ok, concretely: can we sketch updated R/I/E/C numbers quickly? I'll update spreadsheet. Link: https://redwood.sheets/q3-rice-recalc :eyes:
Marco: rough draft: core-routing R=6, I=8, C=12, E=20 -> score ~2.4. seed-features R=9, I=5, C=6, E=8 -> score ~5.6
Jorge: if we apply Lina's blocked multiplier (x1.4) to core-routing E -> drops more. worth normalizing across initiatives.
Priya: can we also run sensitivity: what if impact is overestimated by 30%? need robust picks.
deploy-bot: Reminder: backlog grooming in #product tomorrow 10:00 — add recalibrated RICE rows.
Lina: proposal: pick seed-features as a small canary (MVP shipped to 5% of accounts) while we staff a dedicated triage for core-routing. Parallel path reduces single-point risk.
Marco: +1 to parallel. But need strict rollout gates: perf telemetry, SLA checks, and auto-fallback to hosted models. 
Aisha: agree. for the canary, design can provide a stripped-down flow to hit MVP in one sprint.
Priya: decision for now: prioritize seed-features for Q3 pilot (canary) and allocate exploratory epic for core-routing to surface blocked tasks. we'll re-score RICE after the canary readout (2 weeks). I'll update the sheet and post summary.
Jorge: I'll prepare sensitivity plots and baseline metrics for the readout.
Priya: thanks. tagging @Marco @Lina @Aisha — we'll reconvene after grooming. :thumbsup:
